name: Nemesnép (Hungary)
description: Medium blue field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nemesnép (a crowned blue shield with a white tower, a cross and a wavy stripe, with a helm, a crest and red, blue and yellow mantling) below a scroll inscribed NEMESNÉP.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nemesnép arms with crown, helm, crest, mantling and scroll
